aliases.alias: Southside Data Centre, Land at Clawbare Cottage, Longformacus

summary: Proposed 225 MW data centre campus ('Southside') on moorland and farmland of the Roxburghe Estate at Clawbare Cottage, between Longformacus and Westruther in the Lammermuir Hills, about 11 km west of Duns. Promoted by Sunlaws Development Company Limited (SC121007), a Roxburghe Estates entity. Three two-storey buildings up to 24 m high with an 8.1 ha ground footprint are proposed, marketed as using curtailed local wind generation via the Fallago Rig substation, with a claimed £2bn investment and construction from about 2029 for 2030 operation. EIA screening (25/01835/SCR) concluded in February 2026 that EIA is required; a PAN and June 2026 consultations followed. EIA scoping case 26/01031/SCO was received and validated on 8 July 2026, and Scottish Borders Council issued its scoping opinion on 31 August 2026. No full planning application has been lodged (expected no earlier than late 2026). A 'Save the Lammermuirs' campaign opposes the scheme.
maturity_explanation: Pre-application stage with formal early steps completed: EIA screening 25/01835/SCR concluded on 27 February 2026 that EIA is required; a Proposal of Application Notice was accepted and statutory consultation events were held on 4 and 10 June; EIA scoping case 26/01031/SCO was validated on 8 July and the council issued its scoping opinion on 31 August 2026. No planning application for permission has been validated, so the project remains M1, not M2.
